sql: with lp as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity, realized_pnl, captured_at from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), alimm_tix as (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and status='filled') select lp.market_ticker, lp.quantity, lp.realized_pnl, to_char(lp.captured_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') as last_seen from lp join alimm_tix on lp.market_ticker=alimm_tix.market_ticker order by lp.market_ticker
